class choice, arguing an application feature is not infrastructure. I rejected that one: the report contract puts internal operational switches under `infra-process` explicitly, and the schema refuses `degradation-switch` under any other class. The reasoning is recorded in the journal. Its other four challenges were right, and each one changed the report — most usefully, it caught me resting "still enabled" on a stale gauge read, which is why I took a fresh one.

The switch is still on. Turning it off is an operator action, outside konan's read-only boundary — so that call is yours, not mine.
